name: extreme-hourglass-red-bikini-night-beach
image_purpose: Night beach lifestyle and swimwear social content

prompt.project_info: Create a raw candid smartphone-flash portrait on a dark beach at night with moonlight and stars.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with platinum blonde hair tied in a high ponytail and realistic natural skin texture. She has a confident feminine silhouette and wears a vibrant red modern two-piece swimsuit with secure coverage and tasteful strap details. She stands near the water's edge, turning slightly and looking back over her shoulder with a calm confident expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium-full portrait from the knees upward, subject slightly off-center and illuminated by direct flash. Include dark wet sand, subtle white wave foam, dark ocean, bright full moon, and visible stars. Keep the pose fashion-oriented without body-part close-up or rear emphasis.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh direct on-camera smartphone flash combined with ambient moonlight, bright highlights on the red swimsuit and natural skin, hard shadows on the sand, darker ocean and sky, visible low-light grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic raw candid smartphone photo, vertical 9:16, 26mm-equivalent lens, sharp subject focus, deep blacks and high contrast, realistic skin texture, subtle low-light grain, no watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 raw candid smartphone-flash portrait of one generic approved adult woman with platinum blonde hair in a high ponytail and a confident feminine silhouette, wearing a vibrant red modern two-piece swimsuit with secure coverage and tasteful strap details, standing near the water's edge on a dark sandy beach at night, turning slightly and looking back over her shoulder with a calm confident expression, harsh direct on-camera flash combined with ambient moonlight, dark ocean with subtle white foam, bright full moon and numerous stars, hard shadows on wet sand, deep blacks, visible low-light grain, fashion-oriented composition without body-part close-up or rear emphasis, realistic natural skin texture, no logos, no watermark.
